name: Summer Internship/Minor Project
description: Students will undertake internships within organizations to gain hands-on experience in applying materials perspective. The internship aims to enhance their communication skills, teamwork, and collaborative abilities, while providing exposure to real-world, industry-relevant challenges. Each student will be assigned a project by their industry/research supervisor and will be expected to address such problems using appropriate methodologies.
